caseNameFull: Doneghy, Residuary Trustees v. Alexander, Formerly Collector of Internal Revenue and Doneghy, Residuary Trustees v. Jones, Collector of Internal Revenue
attorneys: Mr. Chas. H. Garnett for petitioners. Assistant Solicitor General Fahy, Assistant Attorney General Clark, and Messrs. Sewall Key, J. Louis Monarch, and William L. Cary for respondents.

opinions.text:
Petition for writs of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit denied.

Mr. Justice Jackson took no part in the consideration and decision of this application.

Reported below: 118 F. 2d 521.
